title: 🔥 WHOEVER CAUSES A LITTLE ONE TO STUMBLE—JESUS' TERRIFYING WARNING! (MATTHEW 18:6) 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 WHOEVER CAUSES A LITTLE ONE TO STUMBLE—JESUS' TERRIFYING WARNING! (MATTHEW 18:6) 🚨🔥
📖 Matthew 18:6 – "But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a heavy millstone hung around his neck, and to be drowned in the depth of the sea."

🚨 Jesus wasn’t playing around when it came to protecting the innocent. He gave one of the most terrifying warnings in all of Scripture: If you lead a child—or a baby Christian—into sin, you’re better off being drowned in the ocean!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "Let people believe whatever they want!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "Teach them the truth so they won’t fall away!" (Proverbs 22:6, Hebrews 5:12-14)
👉 Are you leading others toward Jesus, or are you allowing the world to corrupt them?

🔥 1. JESUS TAKES THE SPIRITUAL PROTECTION OF CHILDREN & BABY CHRISTIANS SERIOUSLY!
📖 Psalm 127:3 – "Children are a heritage from the Lord, offspring a reward from Him."
📖 1 Peter 2:2 – "Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation."

🔥 IN GOD’S EYES:
✅ Children are a blessing, not a burden.
✅ New believers (baby Christians) must be protected and guided.
✅ Those who mislead them will face judgment.

🚨 BUT LOOK AT THE WORLD TODAY!
❌ Schools are teaching kids to reject biblical truth.
❌ Media is poisoning young minds with sin and rebellion.
❌ Churches are failing to disciple new believers, leaving them vulnerable!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many churches today do NOT disciple new believers properly. They get them saved but don’t teach them how to follow Jesus. As a result, they stay spiritually weak and are easily deceived by false teachers.
📖 Hosea 4:6 – "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge."
🚨 IF JESUS WARNED AGAINST CAUSING CHILDREN TO STUMBLE, HOW MUCH MORE WILL HE JUDGE THOSE WHO DESTROY NEW BELIEVERS?

🔥 2. LEADING OTHERS INTO SIN BRINGS HEAVY JUDGMENT!
📖 Luke 17:2 – "It would be better for him to be thrown into the sea with a millstone around his neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble."

🔥 WHAT DOES JESUS MEAN?
👉 A millstone was a massive stone used for grinding grain—it was HEAVY.
👉 Being drowned with one meant NO ESCAPE—CERTAIN DEATH.
👉 Jesus is saying that leading a child or a new believer into sin is SO SERIOUS that drowning would be a "lighter" punishment compared to what awaits in judgment!

🚨 WHO IS JESUS WARNING?
❌ People who expose children to sin and perversion.
❌ False teachers who deceive young believers.
❌ Christians who act hypocritically, causing others to lose faith.

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many new believers are excited about their faith, but when they see "Christians" living like the world—compromising, gossiping, acting selfishly—they become discouraged and fall away.
📖 Romans 14:13 – "Decide never to put a stumbling block or hindrance in the way of a brother."
👉 Will YOUR actions strengthen or weaken the faith of others?

🔥 3. PARENTS, TEACHERS, AND CHURCH LEADERS—YOU ARE ACCOUNTABLE!
📖 Proverbs 22:6 – "Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it."
📖 Hebrews 5:12 – "Though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God’s word all over again."
🚨 RAISING CHILDREN & DISCIPLING NEW BELIEVERS IS NOT OPTIONAL!

🔥 WHAT GOD EXPECTS FROM PARENTS & LEADERS:
✅ TEACH THEM GOD’S WORD—Not just on Sundays, but every day! (Deuteronomy 6:7)
✅ PROTECT THEM FROM CORRUPTION—Guard what they watch, hear, and learn! (Psalm 101:3)
✅ SHOW THEM HOW TO FOLLOW JESUS—Live the example, don’t just speak it! (1 Corinthians 11:1)
🚨 BUT IF YOU FAIL TO TEACH THEM, THE WORLD WILL!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A new believer joins a church but is ignored, never discipled, and eventually goes back to their old sinful life because no one helped them grow.
📖 Ephesians 6:4 – "Do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord."
👉 DON’T LET THIS HAPPEN TO THOSE GOD HAS PLACED UNDER YOUR CARE!

🔥 4. SATAN WANTS TO DESTROY THE NEXT GENERATION & WEAKEN NEW BELIEVERS!
📖 Exodus 1:22 – "Pharaoh gave this order: ‘Throw every Hebrew boy into the Nile, but let the girls live.’"

🔥 IN EVERY GENERATION, SATAN ATTACKS THE WEAK:
❌ Pharaoh killed baby boys in Egypt.
❌ King Herod murdered babies trying to kill Jesus.
❌ Today, millions of unborn babies are killed through abortion.
❌ False teachers deceive and weaken new Christians.
🚨 THIS IS SPIRITUAL WARFARE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many churches today focus on entertainment, not discipleship, leaving new believers spiritually defenseless.
📖 1 Corinthians 3:2 – "I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not ready for it."
👉 WILL YOU LET THE DEVIL STEAL THIS GENERATION, OR WILL YOU STAND FOR THEM?

🔥 5. WHAT MUST YOU DO? PROTECT CHILDREN & BABY CHRISTIANS AT ALL COSTS!
📖 Ephesians 5:11 – "Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them."

🔥 HOW TO PROTECT THE NEXT GENERATION:
✅ TEACH THEM GOD’S WORD DAILY! (Deuteronomy 11:19)
✅ MONITOR WHAT THEY WATCH, READ, AND LISTEN TO! (Psalm 101:3)
✅ PRAY FOR THEM AND WITH THEM! (1 Thessalonians 5:17)
✅ DISCIPLE NEW BELIEVERS—HELP THEM GROW STRONG IN FAITH! (Matthew 28:19-20)
🚨 JESUS IS COMING BACK. ARE YOU READY?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR CHILDREN & NEW BELIEVERS!
"Lord Jesus, protect the hearts and minds of our children and new believers. Expose the lies of the enemy and fill them with Your truth. Give parents and spiritual leaders the courage to raise them in righteousness. Strengthen their faith and keep them from stumbling. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥
